subject: Post-demo next steps: buying path, stakeholder roster & security intake
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ari Cohen <ari@finlink.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo next steps: buying path, stakeholder roster & security intake

Hi Ari / Tara —

Thanks again for your time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on timeline and owners: 

What we heard
- Primary use: customer support document summarization + private knowledge retrieval for billing docs.
- Volume shape: bursty during month-end (30k tokens/day peak), steady background traffic otherwise.
- Must pass FinLink internal security review before pilot.

Suggested next steps
1) I attached a short security intake questionnaire (PDF) — could you confirm a contact on your side to own responses? Prefer someone in InfoSec or cloud compliance.
2) Can you confirm who the economic buyer is (we heard this might be Tara + Head of Ops)? We want to map procurement timing for reserved capacity.
3) Marissa will schedule a 30-min technical follow-up (SRE/arch) to validate systems boundary and data flow (suggest Wed or Thu next week).

To keep things actionable: can you reply with a prioritized list of the stakeholders (econ buyer, procurement, InfoSec reviewer, legal) and a preferred date for the technical sync?

Attachments: redwood_security_questionnaire_20270511.pdf; stakeholder_map_template.xlsx

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Ari Cohen <ari@finlink.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Nair <tara.nair@finlink.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo next steps: buying path, stakeholder roster & security intake

Sergio — thanks, great recap. Quick answers: 

- I'll own coordinating the InfoSec questionnaire but will need technical input from our cloud infra lead (CC'd: Tara).
- Economic buyer is likely Priya Shah (VP, Product) — I'll introduce Priya in a separate thread this week.
- Procurement contact is Ricardo Mendez (ricardo.m@finlink.com) — procurement windows are monthly; next review is 6/01.

We can do the technical sync Thursday 5/13 at 10am PT — that works for Tara and me. Please send a calendar invite with a short agenda (data flows + tokenization/retention model + access controls).

Also: our InfoSec team will want to clarify which systems are in initial pilot scope vs. long-term integration (e.g., BQ logs, SFTP, and internal CRM). We will aim to complete the questionnaire within 5 business days after the technical sync.

—Ari

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ari Cohen <ari@finlink.com>
Cc: Tara Nair <tara.nair@finlink.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo next steps: buying path, stakeholder roster & security intake

Thanks Ari — appreciate the clarity. I've updated the stakeholder map (attached) and turned the questionnaire into a fillable PDF to make internal handoff easier.

Agenda for Thu 5/13 10:00am PT tech sync (proposed, will include calendar invite):
- 10:00–10:10: Introductions & success metrics (Priya / Ops)
- 10:10–10:25: Systems boundary & data flows — Tara + Karthik
- 10:25–10:40: Security controls & evidence required (encryption at rest/in transit, KMS, audit logs, access reviews) — Marissa
- 10:40–10:45: Next steps / procurement timing (Sergio)

Notes / ask: please have someone from your infra team ready to show a simple diagram of the data sources (SFTP -> ingestion -> bigquery) or drop a link to an internal diagram in the thread before the call.

Attachments: stakeholder_map_finlink_v1.xlsx; redwood_security_questionnaire_20270511.pdf

Best,
Sergio

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo next steps: buying path, stakeholder roster & security intake

Sergio — forwarding final note after Ari confirmed attendees. Quick internal checklist before Thu's sync: 
- Karthik: please prepare a 2-slide sketch of the runtime/data boundary and a short list of what artifacts InfoSec will want (SOC2 evidence pointers, sample audit log, KMS/mgmt notes).
- I will draft a procurement timeline slide that maps FinLink's June 1 review window to our pilot milestones and estimated costs for dedicated vs hosted setups.
- Sergio: bring the questionnaire and be prepared to suggest reasonable SLAs and minimum data-retention language (they asked about retention model on call).

Let's coordinate a 20-min run-through at 3pm today if you can — I want to make sure answers are tight for InfoSec.

Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0133
